item.title: 24 · How I AI · 2026-03-30 · How to turn Claude Code into your personal life operating system
item.description:
How I AI · Hilary Gridley (entrepreneur; ex-Head of Core Product, Whoop) · aired March 30, 2026 BUILD · HIGH priority · L4 Memory
Why it's here: Her "anti-system system": rather than configuring preferences up front, Claude Code observes and writes a preference file that improves over time — process memory that accrues instead of being authored. Includes an iPhone back-tap capture shortcut and a 10x-impact rule for what to automate.
Original episode: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pen-name/episodes/How-to-turn-Claude-Code-into-your-personal-life-operating-system--Hilary-Gridley-e3gvpjo

item.description:

Why it's here: Flo Crivello launches Lindy Teammate, an agent that lives in Slack and accumulates a team's shared context, and argues intelligence without accumulated context is worth less than an ordinary coworker — the clearest published case for the Memory layer.

item.title: 26 · Master Claude Chat, Cowork, Code · 2026-05-15 · 15. Managing Context Rot (Thinking Like an Ops Team)
item.description:
Master Claude Chat, Cowork, Code · aired May 15, 2026 Method · HIGH priority · L4 Memory
Why it's here: Context rot as the silent failure mode of long sessions: old decisions linger, rejected ideas stay buried in the thread, and outdated assumptions keep steering the model — the exact decay your supersede-and-archive rules exist to prevent.
Original episode: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/1kpips1/episodes/15--Managing-Context-Rot-Thinking-Like-an-Ops-Team-e3jd233

item.title: 27 · Practical AI · 2026-05-21 · Hermes Agent: Agents that grow with you
item.description:
Practical AI · Jeffrey Quesnelle (co-founder & CTO, Nous Research) · aired May 21, 2026 Method · HIGH priority · L4 Memory
Why it's here: Nous Research's CTO on the closed learning loop inside Hermes Agent: the agent writes its own skill documents from completed tasks and curates a persistent memory file, so capability compounds across sessions instead of resetting.
